  model asks:  tracker__issue_file
                 title: "store.Get returns (nil, nil) for a deleted reminder, so api.owned panics"
                 fingerprint: "fp_4828a6"
                 body: "Reports: cr_1e2ea0 (2x), cr_ee551c (1x), all v1.4.0 (commit 9c41e7a).\n\nCrash: api.(*API).owned (api/reminders.go:144) dereferences nil when POST /v1/reminders/{id}/done is called for a reminder that was already deleted.\n\nCause: store.Get (store/store.go:111-123) handles a tombstoned reminder with `case r.Deleted: r = nil`, and leaves err nil. Its doc comment says deleted reminders are not returned, and every other caller expects an error. api.owned checks only err, so it gets rem == nil and calls rem.UserID.\n\nLog for cr_1e2ea0: rem_0001 was DELETEd at 14:11:02 (204), then POST .../done at 14:12 crashed.\n\nFix: store.Get returns ErrNotFound for a deleted reminder. Reproducer: store/get_deleted_test.go TestGetDeletedReturnsNotFound."
  tool result: filed #103
